items.topic: Superior shoulder suspensory complex and floating shoulder
items.destination_intent: 2026 Shoulder and Elbow OITE teaching page, canonical SSSC and floating shoulder section upon explicit logging
items.teaching_point_placement: After ring components and superior versus inferior supporting struts, before the classic floating shoulder injury pair
items.caption_intent: Exact user-uploaded SSSC diagram. Upper panel identifies the clavicular superior strut and lateral scapular body/glenoid neck inferior strut. Lower panel labels the six ring components: acromion, AC joint, distal clavicle, CC ligaments, coracoid, and glenoid. The humeral shaft is outside this suspension frame.
